claims.text: Baali say they have long been cast as bogeymen who steal children and summon demons; the Greeks named them creatures of Hades and later faiths called them servants of the Devil.
Baali hold that the world was sliding toward death long before they drank their first blood, and that Gehenna is only one theory of its end.
Big stadium shows risk fame enough to expose them, so most Daughters play small, late-night shows in exclusive venues; many find a home among the Toreador.
The Quiet Celebrities handle media manipulation and can build a whole new identity for a singer grown too famous.
Gargoyles are made both by the original ritual and, more often, by the Embrace; ritual-made ones usually come from Kindred tied to the bloodlines the ritual needs.
Chantries traded Sentinel Gargoyles to settle debts and to guard new havens.
Every Gargoyle stays open to mind control from any source; for the variant types Visceratika counts as out of clan.
Disciplines: Auspex, Obfuscate, Flight. All wound penalties double as the body turns back to stone, lasting until the Gargoyle wakes.
Disciplines: Flight, Potence, Fortitude. A Sentinel left truly alone, with no master, mate, ally or friend, has every dice pool halved until it finds someone.
Disciplines: Flight, Fortitude, Protean. Each frenzy turns a chosen body part to stone, harming the matching Attribute.
Harbinger elders insist they are not slaves; the servile role was a ruse kept up for generations and now dropped.
One Harbinger elder claims never to have been Cappadocian and to have seen no sign that Lazarus has anything to do with the line.
Harbingers arrange Elysiums for the Camarilla and esbats for the Sabbat, hiding in plain sight.
The Lasombra tried to bury all knowledge of Marconius, but the Toreador of the Courts of Love found out what had been done.
Kiasyd scholars studied the Abyss, the fae and blood magic, and many fell to mortal inquisitors because of their looks.
Isanwayen taught the line to drink from flayed bodies.
The Nagaraja crave flesh rather than blood, which made them easy to spot; the Camarilla hired assassins, many of them Assamites, to wipe them out.
Survivors hid in societies where eating human flesh was already accepted.
Enoch sheltered Nagaraja lucky enough to be invited; those who go seldom return, and some suspect each newcomer is indoctrinated to obey.
Clients valued the Usurpers for magic used on their behalf, while the Salubri scolded them; with the Salubri gone, disease spread among herds.
Most Salubri hid; only the al-Amin, who embraced Islam, lived openly, treasured by the Ashirra of the Levant.
Mokur, childe and companion of Saulot, is named among the Salubri who survived.

title: Samedi
summary: The corpse-like line of the islands.

claims.text: Born in the islands, the Samedi now live worldwide, mostly alone or in pairs, far from the nights when one Samedi claimed several plantations.
The True Brujah are bound up with the Tal'Mahe'Ra but have their own agendas after centuries of compromise with its other leaders.
The vermin and insects that gather round the Baali become loyal servants; the Baali can speak with them as with Feral Whispers without eye contact and use them as spies.

title: Mosh Pit
summary: A Melpominee power of the Daughters.

claims.text: For a blood point and a Manipulation + Performance roll at a difficulty the singer picks, a target prone to frenzy must resist frenzy at that difficulty.

title: Childer of Typhon, Kin of Hades
summary: A shared Harbinger and Setite power.

claims.text: In ancient Greece the Harbingers called the Setites Childer of Typhon and the Setites called the Harbingers kin of Hades; they made a joint power to keep the souls of slain kin serving their Clans.
The necromancer must fix the target with The Eyes of the Serpent no more than a week before that vampire's Final Death.

With Manipulation + Expression against the sleeper's current Willpower, the Kiasyd narrates a dream; on waking the victim's extended actions are at +2 difficulty and the dream colours the victim's reactions.
The Nagaraja pulls a victim's soul free and devours it as it would any spirit: spend Willpower and roll Manipulation + Empathy at difficulty 7, resisted by the target's Willpower at difficulty 6.
The third eye shows the patient's diseased tissue as light; each success on Perception + Medicine at difficulty 7 reveals one fact about the illness, its course or treatment.
The Samedi spends a blood point and gives the target a piece of hair, nail or skin to swallow; the target's next soak roll gains extra dice.
The True Brujah finds a timeline where the two are old, trusted friends and imprints it on the target, a tool for infiltrating other Sects and Clans.
